title: 1 vs Bot
subtitle: You and the bot get the same pieces in the same order. Three minutes on the clock. Highest score wins.
for_fun: For fun: no tickets, no prizes
level_rookie_desc: Slow and makes mistakes. A good warm-up.
level_pro_desc: Plays steady and keeps the board tidy.
level_master_desc: Plans one piece ahead. Rarely slips.
rule_1: Same seed for both boards: same pieces, same order.
rule_2: The match ends after 3:00, or as soon as one board has no moves left.
rule_3: Higher score at the end wins.
how_to: Tap a piece, then tap the board.
end_bot_stuck: The bot ran out of moves
card_body: Race a bot on the same pieces, or send a friend your exact run and compare scores.
